items.headline: Gen10 launches chat-driven AI for CTRM
items.summary: Gen10 unveiled NaNi, a conversational AI layer for its CommOS platform, plus Conductor.AI for governance, letting desks book trades and check positions via natural language with full audit controls.

items.headline: EMIR Active Account Requirement reporting live
items.summary: Firms subject to EMIR's Active Account Requirement must now file semi-annual AAR reports to national regulators under technical standards that entered into force in February 2026, with France's AMF confirming July submission deadlines.

items.headline: Red Sea and Saudi-linked blockade risks widen
items.summary: Flexport's latest update flags a Saudi-linked blockade as a distinct new disruption layered on existing Red Sea diversions, alongside Cape of Good Hope transit delays expected to persist through Q3.

items.headline: Commodity trade finance market keeps growing
items.summary: Standard Chartered's Global Head of Commodity Trade Finance says the sector is being reshaped by trading-desk relocations and diversification of corridors, with the CTF market projected to reach USD 135 billion by 2030.
